title: Arcane Sanctuary
note: Blizzard's order from conversation.json (trigger groups as listed, lines by conversationOrder).

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: A pocket dimension, created by a mage to store all of their junk.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: As expected, it’s filled with guardian constructs and probably lined with traps as well.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’ll have to use the portals to navigate its halls. Hopefully, there’s something worth the hassle waiting for us at the end.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It looks like this could fit within the portal's frame. I'd wager it's the power source we need.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This portal seems inert. Perhaps it requires a source of power.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: These accursed mages and their little tricks. We'll have to retrace our steps.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This beam could probably activate the next portal if we can remove the obstacles in its path.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It was an illusion! The real artifact must be elsewhere in the vault.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Looks like this is the real artifact.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Finally. Let's get this blasted thing back to Lexington.
